title.narrative: Area-Based-Allocation Multi-sector (Health, protection, S/NFI) response for IDPs and Host Communities in Gereida Buran Bileil and El Salam, South Darfur State Consortium

description.narrative: ltpgtThe Sudan crisis, which commenced on April 15, 2023, has led to significant humanitarian challenges within the country and the wider region. The conflict has resulted in the displacement of millions of people, causing disruption to trade, market functionality, household mobility, humanitarian assistance, and basic service provision. As of October 2023, thousands killed, about 4.8 million individuals have been internally displaced, with over 1 million new IDPs and 345,000 individuals crossing into neighboring countries. Ceasefire agreements have been repeatedly violated, resulting in minimal aid being able to enter Darfur region. In response to this crisis, the project aims to provide life-saving interventions, focusing on the most affected states. ltbrgtThrough this project Alight and consortium partners including United Peace Organization (UPO), Sudanese Organization for Relief and Recovery (SORR), Sudan Social Development Organization (SUDO) and Great Family Organization (GFU) will provide multi sector health, protection, WASH and shelter and NFIs services for the IDPs and host community in Gereida, Buram, Belil, Nyala south and Elsalam for a period of eight months.ltbrgtUnder health, Alight will partner with target 10,500 individuals (3% of total population) as direct Beneficiaries 2,835 (27%) men, 2,940 (28%) women, 2,310 (22%) boys and 2,415 (23%) Girls. Alight will provide health services by establishing a mobile clinic to support targeted people to access basic primary health care services including management of communicable and common non-communicable diseases, maternal and child health, Immunization Services. Additionally, health Education Session, support referrals for complicated cases and Support MOH Vaccination Campaigns. The main objective is to contribute to reduction of morbidity and mortality including those related to maternal complications, vaccine preventable diseases as well as outbreaks.ltbrgtFor Shelter and NFIs sector, Alight in cooperation with UNHCR, proposes to identify, verify, distribute and replenish lifesaving ES/NFIs assistance to most affected households (HH) reaching up to 12,000 people in South Darfur, prioritizing female headed households, children-headed households and vulnerable adults (including the elderly, women, people with disabilities and other people with special needs). Alight will conduct needs assessment to ensure assistance goes primarily to those affected by higher levels of vulnerabilities and post distribution monitoring to collect feedback of beneficiaries on items received in terms of quality. Alight will also coordinate with UPO to provide WASH interventions in Nyala South.ltbrgtFor protection, through this project Alight will partner with SUDO to provide GBV services, GFO for child protection services and will be targeting conflict-affected and extremely vulnerable communities from vulnerable host communities in targeted localities. Alight in coordination with the partners will ensure life-saving services such as MHPSS for adults, survivors and children at risk, referral to specialized services, IPA for PSNs, case management for GBV survivors and UASC, provision of dignity kits, running of Women Center and Child Friendly Space. The intervention will be sustained through community engagements for prevention, mitigation, and response to protection risks Alight will continue to build the capacity of community-based structures such as CBPNs, Child Protection Committees, women groups, through trainings and in-kind support. The structures will be a fundamental partner for Alight for protection monitoring, raising awareness, identifying people at risk, and providing timely support as needed. Alight will improve the AAP establishing a new protection help desk, to promote access to information and assistance for the affected population. The project aims to contribute to the HRP objective 2 for Protection: Mitigate protection risks and respond to protection needs through humanitarian action.ltbrgtlt/pgt
